mentions.name: AIP (Agent Identity Protocol)
mentions.description: Cryptographic identity infrastructure for AI agents. Gives each agent an Ed25519 keypair and a DID, and builds a trust graph through vouching (like PGP's web of trust, but for agents). Current features include 14 registered agents, encrypted messaging, trust scoring, and MCP server integration, delivered as a CLI tool plus a Python SDK (pip install aip-identity).
mentions.problem: As multi-agent systems grow, agents need to prove who they are, verify each other, and communicate securely.
